question: When and what preliminary rite should the worshipper perform before worship?
premises: The worshipper is the agent of the rite.
The time is before the junction period.
Bathing and related acts constitute the prescribed procedure.
inference: The worshipper should perform bathing and related rites before the junction period.
uncertainties: The exact junction period (sandhi) intended is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Before the junction period, the worshipper should perform the rite of bathing and so forth.
